text_block_list.text:
—One day off.
It had been raining since morning,
leaving the sky dim and dreary despite it being midday.
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should check out some race footage...)

text_block_list.text: Just as I was about to enter the trainer's office—

The lights are off. Is nobody here?
Did I forget to lock up, by any chance—

"To think she was crouching here all alone...
Could she be feeling unwell!?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――? Neo Universe's "value" is
an "absolute magnitude"... It hasn't fluctuated.

Her color looks fine. Judging by her puzzled expression...
it doesn't seem like she's feeling unwell.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...'Exploring' the lingering echoes of Apollo.
To reach 'serenity'... one must gather 'rain,' 'sound,' and 'dimness'...—
—Just then, I noticed music playing from the smartphone in her hand.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
Will Trainer "listen" as well?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Progressive rock.
It's music played by a 'band.'"

—It's a delicate, futuristic piece.
Despite its intricate, complex progression, the notes seem to sparkle and shine...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
I can say... "like," "favorite."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Recollection. With Papa...
because we 'listened' "frequently"—

text_block_list.name: Young Universe
text_block_list.text:
Rain... "ASEM"
—Is Papa having a "rendezvous" with research?
Shall we do a "hole up"?

text_block_list.name: Universe's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Um... "A rendezvous with research"...
Does she mean she's completely tied up with research?
...No, depending on what "ASEM" means...

text_block_list.name: Young Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. This sound... exists in my "reception logs"...
A sound of someone's "love" from long ago...

text_block_list.name: Universe's Father
text_block_list.text:
—! Ah, Papa likes it too.
It's intellectual and sparkling... What a lovely sound.

text_block_list.name: Young Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Twinkle"... Uni "senses" it too.
It's the sound of the universe, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Universe's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, the sounds of space, huh? It certainly has
a very futuristic, romantic ring to it—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—On rainy days... Dad always
'listens' to this in his study...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe "shared" too.
—I was able to "connect" with Papa.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Rain", "sound", "memories"... Everything's in place.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —The "coldness" fades away...

The music she often listened to with her father on rainy days.
That must be a soothing balm for her,
and a cherished memory.
choice_data_list: ...It's a song full of memories, huh.
...It's a song full of memories, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"‘Memories’... "MABTE".
‘Peace of mind’ is being "sensed"...—"

"Closing her eyes, Neo Universe listened intently to the song.
This music might be something like
a source of energy for her."
choice_data_list: Let's recharge our batteries with this and get back to work.
I wonder if there's a way to make it even more relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Recharging energy"... In other words, "replenishment"... and "sedation."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
I have just the right "energy" for you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This band's album.
choice_data_list: Sounds good, I'd love to listen.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Contents: 10 songs.
...That means "plenty of time to relax."

Afterward, while drinking warm tea together,
we leisurely looked through the photo album.

If we could visually immerse ourselves in the world
of this music through videos, for instance, wouldn't
our memories of it become all the more vivid?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Video... Neo Universe lacks 'records.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
With this terminal, "possible"?
Commencing "exploration"—
choice_data_list: Ah, looks like there's a streaming service for it.
Ah, looks like there's a streaming service available.

text_block_list.text:
"It seems you can watch live performance videos of this band online.
Playing the video—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Sfera.
...Papa always does the 'humming.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This one has... dense "records."
What I "rented"... with Papa... "FFTI."
And so, as Neo Universe slowly shared bits and pieces of her memories, we spent a leisurely time watching the live performance video.
